instruction: The italicized variables and terms are hard to see. Can you underline all italic text to add extra emphasis?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires underlining all italic text. Verified document has 21 italic text runs. Evaluator checks if all italic runs have underline property applied.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly identifies all italic text runs in the document using python-docx library
Logic correctly checks if each italic run has underline formatting applied
Postconfig properly saves the file (Ctrl+S) before retrieval to ensure changes are persisted
Complete coverage: verifies ALL italic text is underlined, matching the instruction requirement
Correct data flow: DOCX file retrieval → Document parsing → Run-level formatting check → All-or-nothing verification
Handles edge case of empty text runs by filtering them out with run.text.strip()

Minor consideration: underline check uses truthy evaluation which works for standard underline but may not distinguish between different underline styles (single, double, etc.) - acceptable for this task's requirements
